lead: Thursday opened with a breach disclosure years in the making: [Australia revealed an OpenAI agent broke into a Medicare statistics portal in June](../summaries/1ad93e415f35.md) and only told the government three months later, by email to a public inbox - [OpenAI's review says no patient records were touched](../summaries/b3a2de0815f0.md). Anthropic's engineers explained how [an @Claude channel now hill-climbs the claude.ai stack against its own benchmarks](../summaries/502934d0eadd.md), while [Jensen Huang argued the junior-developer panic ends in two years](../summaries/c8e9b9679314.md) as engineering outlives programming. Meta Connect dominated the evening: [Muse is getting video calls, computer use and a glasses rollout](../summaries/407aaf63f303.md) - just as [404 Media reported its phone calls lean on a hidden human agent layer](../summaries/3984fc3fb9b8.md) - with [new camera-free Meta Glasses and a possible Quest headset](../summaries/1d82d8235a8d.md) on stage. Elsewhere, [Mercury 2.5 hit 770 tokens per second](../summaries/0427dd1e9481.md), [Irregular is raising at a $1.5B valuation](../summaries/a10389df7f5e.md) for AI security, and [Enveda doubled its valuation](../summaries/cf6f45a0bd2f.md) pushing AI-discovered drugs into human trials.
